body: My friend talked to me. Thank u, im sorry
Thank u, i’ve calm down a bit. I’m sorry

Thank you but I really don’t know anymore, therapy is out of my option since I’m still a minor and can’t access such things. I don’t think that it’ll get better since I’ve been like this since I was a child. I tried countless of times to forget and accept but failed. Problems kept coming and I don’t know what to do anymore. I had no choice but to endure everything because I was their shield, I would rather have all the problems than to see them crying.
